limitations: Full Sohn (2025) paper was inaccessible, so potentially equivalent Cartier matrices are not ruled out. Abstract trielliptic p-rank-zero irreducibility is established prior work and not claimed here. Newton polygons/Ekedahl-Oort invariants not classified.
scientific_integrity: Exact theorem over algebraically closed characteristic-five fields. Proof uses Cartier identities, discriminant nonsquare specialization and Gauss lemma; finite-field code is corroboration.
title: The irreducible characteristic-five 5-rank divisor of cyclic genus-four quintics
